DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の連絡は、電話でしたか、それともメッセージでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did the contact you want to discuss come by phone or by message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯にメッセージが来ました。今日中に払わないと職場へ連絡すると書いてあって、不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場への連絡を示す支払い要求メッセージへの不安を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a message on my mobile. It says they will contact my workplace if I don't pay today, and I'm worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your concern about a payment demand message threatening to contact your workplace. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容を確認します。すでに返事をしたり、お金を送ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the contents. Have you already replied or sent any money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。リンクを開く前に相談しようと思って、ここへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返信も送金もせずリンクを開く前に相談に来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've done neither. I came here because I thought I should ask for advice before opening the link.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have neither replied nor sent money and came for advice before opening the link. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま開かず、送信元と文面を見せてください。画面の記録も残しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Leave it unopened and show me the sender and wording. Let's also keep a record of the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このスクリーンショットには文面しか写っていません。送信元と受信時刻も保存しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録に送信元と受信時刻も必要か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This screenshot only shows the wording. Should I save the sender and the time received too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the record also needs the sender and time received. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、それらがわかる画面も保存してください。元のメッセージは消さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please save screens showing those too. Don't delete the original message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: また連絡が来ても、返事をせずに保存してから、こちらに追加で相談してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加連絡は返信せず保存して相談してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they contact me again, may I save it without replying and then come back here for further advice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can save further contact without replying and seek advice. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 構いません。届いた日時と内容を整理すると確認しやすくなります。これから詳しくお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Organizing the dates, times, and contents will make them easier to check. I'll now listen to the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最初の連絡と、その後の連絡を分けて記録します。支払いも返信もせず、相談を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡を時系列で記録し支払いも返信も保留して相談を続けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll record the first contact separately from later messages. I'll continue seeking advice without paying or replying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep a chronological record of the contact and continue seeking advice while holding off on payment and replies. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、奥の相談席で伺います。こちらの受付案内は以上です。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll hear your story at the consultation desk farther inside. That completes the reception guidance here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の中身を教えてください。箱の中で音がしているようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what is in your parcel. It sounds as though something is rattling inside the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 陶器のカップが二つ入っています。紙で包んだのですが、持ち上げると中で動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 陶器二つが包んでも箱の中で動くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two ceramic cups. I wrapped them in paper, but they move inside when I lift the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the two ceramic items move inside the box even though they are wrapped. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 割れやすいものですね。中で動かないよう、緩衝材で隙間を埋める必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are fragile. You need to fill the gaps with cushioning material so they won't move inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この状態のまま「割れ物」と書けば大丈夫だと思っていました。表示だけでは足りないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 割れ物表示だけでは保護が不足すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it would be fine if I just wrote “fragile” on it as it is. So a label alone isn't enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that a fragile label alone does not provide enough protection. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、表示だけで破損を防げるわけではありません。包み方を見直してからお預けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right; a label alone cannot prevent damage. Please review the packing before handing it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は持ち帰って詰め直します。二つが触れないよう、一つずつ包んだほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち帰って二つを個別に包む方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take it home and repack it today. Should I wrap each one separately so the two won't touch?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about taking them home and wrapping the two items separately. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一つずつ保護し、互いにぶつからないようにしてください。箱自体の強さも確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Protect each one separately so they won't knock against each other. Check the strength of the box itself too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 梱包を直すと大きさが変わりそうです。送料は完成した箱を持ってきてから確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 梱包後の大きさで送料を確認してもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The size may change when I fix the packing. Can you check the postage after I bring the finished box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the postage can be checked using the size after packing. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、発送先と完成した荷物を確認してご案内します。宛名も読める状態でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll check the destination and the completed parcel and explain the postage. Bring it with the addressee's details legible too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: カップを別々に保護して隙間を埋め、箱と宛名を整えてから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個別保護と隙間埋めと宛名準備の後に再持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll protect the cups separately, fill the gaps, and prepare the box and addressee's details before bringing it back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will bring it back after protecting each item, filling the gaps, and preparing the addressee's details. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その状態で拝見します。本日はまだお預かりしません。では、お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll inspect it in that condition. We won't accept it today. Please take care carrying it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 確認画面で止まっているのですね。まだ振込の確定は押していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're at the confirmation screen, correct? You haven't pressed the button to finalize the transfer yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。請求書の会社名と、画面に出た口座名義が違うので、進めてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未確定画面の口座名義と請求会社名の相違を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. The company name on the invoice differs from the account holder's name on the screen, so I'm unsure whether to proceed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the account holder on the unconfirmed screen differs from the invoicing company. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名義が違うまま確定するのは避けましょう。入力した銀行名、支店、口座番号を照合できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's avoid finalizing it while the names differ. Can you check the bank name, branch, and account number you entered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号は請求書と同じでした。ただ、会社から新しい振込先だと言われたので、変更の理由は聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号は一致するが口座変更理由は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number matched the invoice. But the company only said it was a new payment account, so I haven't asked why it changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the number matches but you have not confirmed the reason for the account change. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行から請求の正当性は確認できません。以前から知っている会社の連絡先へ、変更内容を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The bank cannot verify whether the invoice is legitimate. Check the changes using the company's contact details you already knew.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メールの番号ではなく、前から使っている会社の電話番号にかけます。今の操作は取り消せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既知の連絡先へ電話すると決め振込操作取消を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll call the company's number I've used before, not the number in the email. Can I cancel this operation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to call a known contact and ask about canceling the transfer operation. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この画面ではまだ未確定なので、戻る操作で終了できます。終了した画面を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is not finalized on this screen yet, so you can exit by going back. Let's check the screen after you exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 終了できました。確認後に振り込む場合、手数料は確定する前に見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 操作終了を報告し手数料を確定前に確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've exited. If I make the transfer after checking, can I see the fee before finalizing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you exited and ask whether the fee can be checked before finalizing. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 振込内容の確認画面で表示を確かめてください。金額や条件がわからなければ、確定せず窓口へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the display on the transfer-details confirmation screen. If you don't understand the amount or conditions, don't finalize it; ask at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に会社へ口座変更を確認します。再操作するときは名義と手数料を見てから判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社確認を先に行い再操作時は名義と手数料で判断すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first confirm the account change with the company. When I try again, I'll look at the account holder and fee before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check with the company first and judge by the account holder and fee when trying again. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日は振込を行っていません。では、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. You have not made a transfer today. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の前に、袋はお持ちでしょうか。冷たい食品も入っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before we total your purchases, have you brought a bag? There are cold foods too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 布の袋はありますが、洗剤とヨーグルトを一緒に入れたくありません。食品用に袋を一枚ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 布袋を持参したが洗剤と食品を分けるため袋一枚を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a cloth bag, but I don't want to put detergent and yogurt together. Please give me one bag for the food.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought a cloth bag but ask for one bag to separate detergent and food. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋一枚を追加します。こちらは有料です。布の袋には洗剤を入れる形でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll add one bag. There is a charge for it. Is it all right to put the detergent in the cloth bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、その分け方でお願いします。袋の分を含めた合計を、支払う前に見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋分けに同意し袋代込みの合計確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please separate them that way. I'd like to see the total including the bag before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Agree to the bag separation and ask to check the total including the bag charge. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの表示が袋を含めた合計です。確認してからお支払いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This display shows the total including the bag. Please check it before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金額を確認しました。このカードで払いたいのですが、使える種類か見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合計を確認しカードが対応するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've checked the amount. I'd like to pay with this card; could you check whether this type is accepted?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the total and ask whether your card is supported. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: このレジでは対応している種類です。端末の表示が出てから、ご自分でカードを操作してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This register accepts that type. Please operate the card yourself once the terminal shows the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 端末に二つ選択肢が出ました。読めないので、操作する前に意味を説明していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 端末の二つの選択肢の意味を操作前に聞き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are two options on the terminal. I can't read them, so could you explain what they mean before I do anything?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what the two terminal options mean before operating it. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 画面の文字を一緒に確認します。こちらが今回のお支払い方法の選択です。暗証番号はご自分で入力してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the words on the screen together. This is where you select the payment method for this purchase. Please enter your PIN yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 選択肢がわかりました。自分で入力します。食品の袋と洗剤の袋を別々に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分で入力し食品と洗剤を別袋で持ち帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the options now. I'll enter it myself. I'll take the food bag and detergent bag home separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will enter it yourself and take the food and detergent home in separate bags. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お支払いが終わりましたらレシートもお受け取りください。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Once payment is complete, please take the receipt too. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の経路をお探しですか。長く歩く予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a walking route? Are you planning a long walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 久しぶりに歩くので、十五分くらいにしたいです。坂の少ない道を選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 久しぶりの散歩なので十五分程度で坂の少ない道を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's been a while since I last went walking, so I'd like about fifteen minutes. Can I choose a route with few slopes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a walk of about fifteen minutes with few slopes because it has been a while. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この地図では、入口周辺の短い道が比較的平らです。池の向こう側へ行く道には坂があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this map, the short route around the entrance is relatively flat. The route to the far side of the pond has slopes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口周辺にします。途中で疲れたら休める場所も、地図で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口周辺を選び休憩場所を地図で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll stay around the entrance. Please also show me places to rest on the map in case I get tired along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the entrance area and ask for rest places on the map. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この道沿いのベンチが休憩場所です。疲れを感じたら引き返して構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The benches along this path are places to rest. You may turn back if you feel tired.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰りに迷わないように、入ってきた南側の入口へ戻る目印を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 南側入口へ戻る目印を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like a landmark for returning to the south entrance where I came in so I won't get lost on the way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the landmark for returning to the south entrance. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地図の現在地と南側入口を線で結びます。この案内板まで戻れば入口が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll draw a line between your current location and the south entrance on the map. If you come back to this information board, you can see the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 池の方へ進まず、この案内板を目指して戻るということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 池へ進まず案内板へ戻る方向を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should return toward this information board rather than continue toward the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will return toward the information board rather than head for the pond. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。地図をお持ちください。歩く時間は体調に合わせ、無理に一周しようとしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please take the map. Adjust the time you walk to how you feel and don't force yourself to complete a circuit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 地図を持って短い道を歩きます。疲れたらベンチで休んで、南側入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図を携帯し疲れたら休んで南側入口へ戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the map and walk the short route. If I get tired, I'll rest on a bench and return to the south entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to carry the map, rest if tired, and return to the south entrance. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞご自分のペースでお楽しみください。では、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy it at your own pace. Have a pleasant walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発車案内をご覧になっていますね。乗る予定の列車は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the departure information. Have you decided which train to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十一時二十分の列車です。到着駅で兄が待っているので、いま何分遅れているか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十一時二十分の列車に乗り兄が到着駅で待つ事情を伝え現在の遅れを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The eleven twenty train. My older brother is waiting at the arrival station, so I'd like to know how many minutes late it is now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will take the eleven twenty train and your older brother is waiting at the destination, and ask the current delay. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 掲示では二十分程度の遅れです。ただ、到着時刻もその分ずれるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The board says about twenty minutes late. But that does not necessarily mean the arrival time will shift by that same amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 兄には二十分遅れると断定せず、到着時刻がまだ決まらないと伝えた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄に遅延時間を断定せず到着時刻が未定と伝えるべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Should I tell my brother that the arrival time is still undetermined rather than say definitely that I'll be twenty minutes late?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether to tell your brother the arrival time is undetermined without stating a definite delay. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、今の案内は発車の見込みです。到着の見込みが出たら、その情報もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, the current information is an estimate for departure. When an arrival estimate is issued, please check that information too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡をする間、改札の外で待っていても乗り遅れませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連絡中に改札の外で待っても乗車に間に合うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: While I contact him, can I wait outside the ticket gates without missing the train?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can wait outside the gates while making contact and still board in time. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改札の外だと放送が聞こえにくい所もあります。改札内の待合スペースなら案内を確認しながら連絡できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: In some places outside the gates, announcements are hard to hear. In the waiting area inside the gates, you can contact him while checking the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待合スペースへ行きます。乗り場は掲示の二番線のままでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待合スペースへ移ると伝え二番線のままか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll go to the waiting area. Is the platform still number two as shown on the board?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will move to the waiting area and check whether it is still platform two. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現時点では二番線です。変更される場合は掲示と放送で案内しますので、乗る直前にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is platform two at present. If it changes, we'll announce it on the board and over the speakers, so check again just before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 兄には到着時刻が未定だと連絡して、待合スペースで二番線の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 兄への未定の連絡と待合スペースでの乗り場確認を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my brother the arrival time is undetermined and check the platform two information in the waiting area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to tell your brother the time is undetermined and check the platform in the waiting area. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気をつけてご乗車ください。案内が更新されたらご覧くださいね。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care boarding. Please check when the information is updated. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 生活相談をご希望ですね。今日は相談内容を整理するところからお手伝いできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about daily life. Today we can help you start by organizing what you want to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りている部屋の契約について手紙が来ました。内容を一人で読めないので、相談の予約をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 賃貸契約の手紙を一人で読めず相談予約をしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've received a letter about the lease for my room. I can't read it on my own, so I'd like to book a consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot read the rental-contract letter alone and want to book a consultation. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この受付で契約の判断はできませんが、相談を受けられる担当を確認します。手紙は持っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't make judgments about the contract at this reception desk, but we'll check who can advise you. Have you brought the letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 封筒と手紙を持ってきました。返事の期限が来週なので、その前に話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒と手紙を持参し来週の返答期限前に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've brought the envelope and letter. The reply deadline is next week, so I'd like to talk before then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought the envelope and letter and want advice before next week's reply deadline. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 期限も含めて担当へ伝えましょう。予約の案内を受ける際、都合のよい時間を伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's tell the staff member responsible about the deadline too. When you receive booking guidance, can you tell them a convenient time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夜勤があるため、午後なら起きています。火曜か木曜の午後を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夜勤のため火曜か木曜の午後を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I work nights, so I'm awake in the afternoon. I'd prefer Tuesday or Thursday afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you prefer Tuesday or Thursday afternoon because you work nights. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二つの候補を担当へ伝えて、空きを尋ねてください。ご希望の言語による支援も一緒に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the staff member those two options and ask about availability. You can also check support in your preferred language at the same time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベトナム語で相談したいです。通訳が利用できる日を確認してから日時を決められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベトナム語通訳の利用可能日を確認してから日時を決めたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to consult in Vietnamese. Can I choose the date and time after checking which days a Vietnamese interpreter is available?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to decide the date and time after checking days when a Vietnamese interpreter is available. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に確認してから決めましょう。こちらに相談先の連絡方法を書きますので、希望日と期限も一緒に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's decide after checking with the staff member. I'll write the consultation contact details here, so tell them your preferred days and the deadline too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この連絡先へ、火曜か木曜の午後とベトナム語の希望を伝えます。手紙の返事の期限も説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 示された相談先へ希望時間と言語と期限を説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell this contact I prefer Tuesday or Thursday afternoon and Vietnamese. I'll also explain the deadline for replying to the letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain your preferred time, language, and deadline to the consultation contact provided. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約が決まったら、日時と持ち物もお確かめください。それではお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once the booking is set, check the date, time, and what to bring too. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察は終わっていますね。お帰りになる前に、確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your consultation is finished. Is there anything you want to check before leaving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計を済ませましたが、もらった領収書が見当たりません。職場に出すので、もう一枚もらえるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計後の領収書紛失と職場提出のため再発行を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've paid, but I can't find the receipt I was given. I need to submit it at work; could I have another copy?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lost the receipt after paying and want it reissued for submission at work. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書の扱いは会計窓口で確認します。まず、診察券はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check how receipts are handled at the payment counter. First, do you have your patient card with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 診察券はあります。領収書は、会計のあとに座った椅子の辺りで落としたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察券があり会計後の椅子付近で落とした可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my patient card. I may have dropped the receipt near the chair where I sat after paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have your patient card and may have dropped the receipt near the chair after paying. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場所の落とし物も受付に尋ねてみましょう。職場には領収書を提出するように言われていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask reception about lost property at that location too. Did your workplace tell you to submit a receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上司には受診したことがわかる紙と言われただけです。診断書が必要か、先に職場へ聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場の曖昧な書類指定を伝え診断書が必要か先に確認したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My supervisor only said a paper showing that I saw a doctor. May I first ask my workplace whether a medical certificate is needed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the vague document request from work and ask to check first whether a medical certificate is needed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、書類を申し込む前に確かめるとよいです。診断書が必要なら、申請する窓口と医師への確認について受付で聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, it's best to check before applying for documents. If a medical certificate is needed, reception can tell you where to apply and about checking with the doctor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診断書が必要と言われた場合、費用と受け取り日も申し込み前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診断書が必要な場合の費用と受取日を申し込み前に知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they say a medical certificate is needed, I'd like to ask the cost and collection date before applying too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to know the cost and collection date before applying if a medical certificate is required. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それも書類の担当へお伝えください。領収書の相談と診断書の申請は、用件を分けて話すと伝わりやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the staff responsible for documents that too. Separating your inquiry about the receipt from the medical-certificate application will make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず職場に必要な書類を聞きます。会計窓口では診察券を見せて、領収書と落とし物を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 職場確認を先に行い診察券を見せ領収書と落とし物を窓口で相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first ask my workplace which document is needed. At the payment counter, I'll show my patient card and ask about the receipt and lost property.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check with work first, show your patient card, and ask at the counter about the receipt and lost property. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付までの道はこちらです。お大事になさってください。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: This is the way to reception. Take care of yourself. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物のご相談ですか。何をなくされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about lost property? What have you lost?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家と自転車の鍵をまとめたキーホルダーをなくしました。今朝から見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家と自転車の鍵をまとめたキーホルダーを今朝からなくしていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've lost the key ring holding my house and bicycle keys together. I haven't been able to find it since this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the key ring holding your house and bicycle keys has been missing since this morning. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に使った場面を、思い出せる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me what you remember about the last time you used it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝八時に自転車を公園の駐輪場へ止めました。そのあと図書館へ歩き、帰りに鍵がないと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 八時の公園駐輪と図書館への移動と紛失発見の順序を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At eight this morning I parked my bicycle in the park's bicycle parking area. Then I walked to the library and noticed the keys were missing on my way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in order parking at the park at eight, going to the library, and discovering the loss. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 公園で使ったあと、図書館から帰るまでに気づかれたのですね。鍵の本数とキーホルダーの特徴はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So after using them at the park, you noticed by the time you were returning from the library. Do you know the number of keys and the key ring's features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鍵は二本で、青い布の札が付いています。札の端には白い糸で小さな星が縫ってあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵が二本で青い布札と白い糸の星模様があると具体的に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two keys with a blue cloth tag. A small star is sewn in white thread at the edge of the tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe specifically the two keys, blue cloth tag, and star design in white thread. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴を届け出に記録しましょう。お名前や住所が鍵に書かれていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's record those details in the report. Is your name or address written on the keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前も住所も書いていません。星の模様は、自分で縫ったので形が少し歪んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前と住所が記載されず手縫いの星が歪んでいると補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Neither my name nor address is written. I sewed the star myself, so its shape is a little crooked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add that no name or address is written and the hand-sewn star is crooked. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 識別の手がかりになりますね。見つかった際に連絡できる電話番号を、こちらへ記入していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will help identify them. Could you write a phone number here where we can reach you if found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯の番号を書きます。仕事中に出られなかったら、着信を確認してこちらへ折り返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯番号を記入し仕事中に応答できなければ署へ折り返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write my mobile number. If I can't answer while working, I'll check the missed call and call you back here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will write your mobile number and call the station back if you cannot answer at work. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号を確認しました。届け出の控えをお持ちください。無事に見つかるといいですね。それではお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've checked the number. Please take your copy of the report. I hope they turn up safely. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票についてのご相談ですね。票を拝見してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to ask about a missed-delivery notice. May I look at it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨で濡れてしまい、番号の一桁が読めません。この票で荷物を探せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨で不在票の番号の一桁が読めず荷物の照合が可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It got wet in the rain, and I can't read one digit of the number. Can you locate the parcel using this notice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say rain made one digit of the missed-delivery notice number unreadable and ask whether the parcel can be matched. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読める部分を確認します。宛名と住所も照合したいので、こちらで教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the legible parts. I'd also like to match the addressee and address, so could you tell me here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛名はグエン・アンで、住所はこちらです。部屋番号は二〇三です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名と住所と二〇三の部屋番号を窓口で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The addressee is Nguyen An, and this is the address. The room number is two-zero-three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the addressee, address, and room number two-zero-three at the counter. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。荷物の確認ができました。この荷物は別の受取窓口に保管されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. We've identified the parcel. It is stored at a different collection counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで受け取れると思っていました。保管先の窓口と受け取りに行ける時間を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の保管先の窓口と受取可能時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought I could collect it here. Please tell me the counter where it is stored and the times I can collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the other storage counter and available collection times. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この荷物の受取窓口と受付時間を案内用紙に書きます。行く前に用意する書類も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll write this parcel's collection counter and opening hours on the guidance sheet. Let's also check the documents to prepare before going.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で受け取りに行きます。不在票と本人確認書類を持って行けばよいか、確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が受け取りに行くと伝え不在票と本人確認書類でよいか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll collect it myself. Please check whether I should bring the notice and identification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will collect it yourself and ask whether the notice and identification are sufficient. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この荷物はその二つをご用意ください。番号の読めない部分は、こちらに確認できた番号を書き添えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please prepare those two for this parcel. For the unreadable section, I've added the number we were able to confirm here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書き添えてもらった番号と保管先を確認しました。受付時間を見て、本人確認書類と不在票を持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追記された番号と保管先を確認し受付時間に書類と票を持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the added number and storage location. I'll check the opening hours and bring my identification and notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the added number and storage location and say you will bring the documents and notice during opening hours. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 保管期限も用紙に記しましたのでご確認ください。それでは、受け取りの際はお気をつけてお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've also written the storage deadline on the sheet, so please check it. Take care on your way to collect it.
